summary: Ha Giang is the northern loop. Sapa is the town above the terraces. The highlands are coffee, pine, and crater lakes.
body: The Ha Giang Loop leaves town toward Quan Ba, Yen Minh, Dong Van, and Meo Vac. Ma Pi Leng is the famous stretch. It is a motorbike journey for licensed riders, or a car with a driver. Cao Bang is the other northern road: Ban Gioc in the morning, from the Vietnam bank of the Quay Son, and Phia Oac on its own day west of the city.

Sapa is the highland base near the Chinese border, for terraces, market days, and Fansipan. Mist is part of the place. Da Lat is the pine ridges and Xuan Huong. Mang Den is a cool plateau near 1,200 m in Kon Plông, not a neighborhood of Kon Tum city. Pleiku’s Biển Hồ is a volcanic crater lake about 7 km north of town. Sam Mountain in Châu Đốc is a morning on foot, with the temple roofs at the foot.
